title: When the Verdict Turns
author: Freya Eriksen
blurb: Wendell Eastwick, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
